messages:
Priya Nair: Hey — did anyone else get a page for db-replica-2 around 09:12 UTC? I see the page was sent but the incident thread in #incidents never popped up. this might be bot/webhook related.
Liam Chen: I got the phone page at 09:12 but no slack thread. I checked the incident-bot message feed and it shows 'delivered' to pager but not to slack.
Elena Gomez: OpsBot shows a backlog on the webhook queue around that time. queue_length spiked to ~430 for ~3m. (reaction :eyes:)
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Pager sent to oncall (rule: db-primary). Webhook delivery to #incidents delayed by 2m 14s. status=200 body="ok"
Jorge Alvarez: can someone paste the small webhook log? curious if it's a downstream rate-limit or an ack issue.
Priya Nair: grabbing logs now — looks like outgoing webhook POSTs were queued, then processed in a burst. relevant snippet: ```
[2026-03-15T09:12:05Z] enqueue event_id=evt_9a1c
[2026-03-15T09:12:07Z] send attempt=1 event_id=evt_9a1c -> 200 (latency=135ms)
[2026-03-15T09:12:10Z] send attempt=2 event_id=evt_9a1c -> 200 (latency=2.1s)
[2026-03-15T09:14:19Z] processed queued webhook event_id=evt_9a1c -> forwarded to slack channel #incidents (latency=124s)
```
Liam Chen: 124s delay between enqueue and final processing — yikes. that would explain thread creation delay and the missed handoff during the rotation.
Elena Gomez: OpsBot metrics: redis-list-length peaked due to a consumer restart on eng-ops-webhooks. consumer PID 3421 OOM-killed around 09:11 and restarted slowly.
Jorge Alvarez: Are we sure it was OOM? I see the container had a GC pause in the logs and then the process restarted. either way consumer lag caused delivery delay.
Priya Nair: Customer impact: one page reached oncall, but the #incidents workflow (auto-create incident thread + runbook posting + canary pagerduty link) was delayed — potential missing context for whoever answered the phone. No outage extension, but degraded automation.
IncidentBot: Note: automatic handoff automation uses webhook acknowledgements within 30s for fast thread creation. Several webhook events exceeded that window.
Elena Gomez: Mitigation applied: restarted webhook consumer with increased memory limit, temporarily switched to synchronous forwarding for high-severity pages (bypasses queue), and manually created the incident thread for db-replica-2 at 09:15.
Liam Chen: Manual escalation: I DM'd oncall and posted the runbook link. Also bumped the mobile escalation to ensure coverage until automation is stable.
Jorge Alvarez: Quick patch: bump retry/backoff to avoid queue storms on restart. Also add a webhook consumer liveness alert if queue_length > 100 for >1m.
Priya Nair: Can we add a secondary path? If queued delivery exceeds 45s, IncidentBot should call out to PagerFlow API to ensure slack thread + runbook are created via the control plane.
Elena Gomez: Sounds good. I'll open a follow-up ticket. short-term: increase consumer memory to 1.5GB and add readiness probe backoff. long-term: add active health-check + circuit-breaker so we don't spike queue on consumer restarts.
IncidentBot: Action recorded: create ticket INF-6423 (webhook consumer resilience).
Priya Nair: FYI I'm going to annotate the incident timeline in the ticket. Everyone, please add any missed manual steps you did in the thread so we have a clear post-incident log.
Liam Chen: I added in the phone escalation timeline and the manual thread link.
Jorge Alvarez: I'll draft a blameless RCA focusing on memory tuning + backpressure.
Elena Gomez: Postmortem checklist: reproduce locally with consumer restart, validate queue metrics pipeline, add new alert, and run a DR drill for oncall handoffs when automation is unavailable.
Priya Nair: Thanks team. We'll keep #incidents updated — reassigning to eng-infra for the fix. tagging @eng-infra (notified). (reaction :white_check_mark:)
OpsBot: webhook_consumer_restart event recorded by ops-autoscaler at 2026-03-15T09:11:58Z. container_restart_count=1
IncidentBot: Closing note: no customer-facing downtime recorded. Automation gap increased toil and time-to-awareness for this event. Follow-up ticket INF-6423 created and assigned to eng-infra.
Elena Gomez: Closing: I'll schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow to go over the mitigation plan and make sure alerts trigger correctly.
Priya Nair: End of thread. Thanks all.
